brief.title: Calibrate candidate self-rewarding rubric judges against deterministic ground-truth verifiers
brief.plain_summary: Evaluate rubric judge approvals against deterministic verifier outcomes using Cohen's kappa, exact agreement and false-positive approval rate bounds, blocking synthetic pairs when calibration fails.
brief.outcome: Rubric judge calibration scorecard and admitted/blocked synthetic pair counts.

calibration_bundle.description: Pin of paired rubric judge predictions, deterministic verifier verdicts and candidate synthetic pairs.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.rubric_judge_calibrated: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.

acceptance_checks.check: Uncalibrated rubric judges admit zero synthetic pairs while calibrated judges satisfy kappa and false-positive bounds.

creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Load Cohen's kappa, exact agreement and false-positive rate bounds from default_grid_spec.json.

Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

brief.title: Curate preference pairs with Iterative RPO NLL regularization, length bounds and 3-key deduplication
